timeline.summary: On April 2, 2026, Talbros Automotive Components submitted annual disclosures under Regulation 31(4) showing zero promoter share encumbrance.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹236.55 Cr (+14.9% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹31.62 Cr.
On May 20, 2026, Talbros Automotive Components released its Q4 & FY26 investor presentation reporting ₹870.0 Cr annual revenue and announcing CEO appointment.
Q4 & FY26 press release (consolidated): Q4FY26 total income ₹241 Cr (+14% YoY), EBITDA ₹45 Cr, PAT ₹32 Cr; FY26 revenue ₹890 Cr (+5%), and Ashish Gupta named CEO.
On May 21, 2026, Talbros Automotive Components held its Q4 & FY26 earnings call, guiding for 15-20% revenue growth in FY27 and announcing Ashish Gupta as CEO.
